phase: P0 release-blocker: fix payCallback undeclared-symbol ReferenceError (valid signed callback could not finalize); add real payCallback.main() E2E; verify unique indexes; harden payCallback env deploy script

changes.P0_FIX: payCallback/index.js after AES-GCM decrypt now binds the provider fields from the decrypted payload: `const { out_trade_no, transaction_id, trade_state, amount, mchid, appid } = decrypted`. Previously these symbols were referenced without declaration (destructure removed by refactor 305a2f0) → ReferenceError → catch → HTTP 500 INTERNAL_ERROR, so the async callback channel could never finalize a paid order. Fix aligns with the required authority order: verify_signature → verify_public_key_id → decrypt_resource → validate_event_type → bind_provider_fields → validate_out_trade_no → validate_trade_state_SUCCESS → call shared finalizePaidOrder → HTTP 200.
changes.EVENT_TYPE_GUARD: Added step 7.1: non-`TRANSACTION.SUCCESS` events are safely acknowledged (200) without granting value (fail-closed).
changes.E2E_TEST: NEW tests/rc8.9/paycallback-main-e2e.test.js — loads the REAL payCallback/index.js in a vm sandbox (stub wx-server-sdk + REAL paymentAuthority/paymentFinalizer/entitlementService) and exercises a fully signed+encrypted callback end-to-end (A..L): valid SUCCESS=200+finalize once+fields bound; invalid sig/wrong key id/decrypt fail rejected; trade_state!=SUCCESS acked no-finalize; amount/mchid/appid mismatch rejected; missing transaction_id rejected; duplicate callback idempotent (one payment row, one entitlement); callback+verify concurrent (one paid/payment/entitlement); no-ReferenceError regression pin; source binding guard.
